blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos has reassigned Vince Dizon to head the Department of Transportation (DOTr) and appointed Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez as secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Presidential Communications Office Acting Secretary Lino Cayetano announced on Monday. The agency swap marks the latest shake-up in Marcos’ Cabinet. READ: New PCO chief keeping Castro as she’s ‘a treasure in this gov’t’ Dizon previously served as transportation secretary from February to September 2025 before being reassigned to the DPWH.
